notes.title: Easter holidays are coming soon!
notes.notes:
Easter weekend is coming! Time for holiday adventures and special bonuses! Thematic surprises await you on the updated map. Be prepared for colourfull eggs, rabbits, carrots and Easter cake. Each item has its own special sense. Collect treasures and be rewarded with an amazing quadcopter. That will expand your capabilities in future explorations. Every treasure can be exchanged for new clothes to emphasize the status of a cool explorer. Join the celebration and become the owner of nice bonuses! 🐣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178685/7d089aa8a97afdaebaafe416467d847666fbf312.jpg[/img]

Let the month be filled with surprises and fascinating excavations!

Best regards,
Ulab Games Team

notes.title: Treasure Hunter v.1.122.2 Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178685/e0c20506b8dfd5f187e80ba2d91b4bde28929c0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178685/752739b00fe7b022610031806accabc3f4fb7d58.png[/img]

[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed problems with shadows
[*] Display errors of roads and fields have been corrected.
[*] The positions of environmental objects on the map have been fixed.
[*] A sound for item cleaning has been added.
[*] A yellow color pinpointer marker has been added.
[*] New textures have been added to objects.
[*] All settlement name labels on signs have been added.
[*] Grass display issues have been fixed.
[*] Descriptions of some finds have been corrected.
[*] Descriptions of hints have been corrected.
[/list]
